schema.content:
Table "Addresses" {
  "address_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "line_1_number_building" TEXT
  "city" TEXT
  "zip_postcode" TEXT
  "state_province_county" TEXT
  "country" TEXT
}

Table "Contacts" {
  "contact_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "customer_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "gender" TEXT
  "first_name" TEXT
  "last_name" TEXT
  "contact_phone" TEXT
}

Table "Customer_Address_History" {
  "customer_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "address_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "date_from" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "date_to" TIMESTAMP
}

Table "Customer_Orders" {
  "order_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "customer_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "order_date" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "order_status_code" TEXT
}

Table "Customers" {
  "customer_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "payment_method_code" TEXT
  "customer_number" TEXT
  "customer_name" TEXT
  "customer_address" TEXT
  "customer_phone" TEXT
  "customer_email" TEXT
}

Table "Order_Items" {
  "order_item_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "order_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "product_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "order_quantity" TEXT
}

Table "Products" {
  "product_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "product_type_code" TEXT
  "product_name" TEXT
  "product_price" REAL
}



Ref: "Customer_Address_History"."address_id" > "Addresses"."address_id"

Ref: "Customer_Address_History"."customer_id" > "Customers"."customer_id"

Ref: "Customer_Orders"."customer_id" > "Customers"."customer_id"

Ref: "Order_Items"."order_id" > "Customer_Orders"."order_id"

Ref: "Order_Items"."product_id" > "Products"."product_id"
